event.selection_basis: PG&E's CPUC-hosted report lists Tehama among the three affected counties and gives a Tehama CORNING circuit planned de-energization at 2023-09-20 23:19 PDT; it also reports a Tehama station maximum gust. This is planned de-energization evidence only.
exclusions: Full annual EAGLE-I scan has 22 of 24 expected timestamps; this is an UncoveredLabel shortfall.
uncertainties: The canonical interval contains Tehama CORNING circuit activation, but a circuit footprint is not a whole-county outage observation.
The reported 36 mph Tehama maximum gust is a county-scope station summary, not a complete six-hour county weather series.
The utility report is not independent verification of wildfire causation, fire occurrence, or a county outage label.
